answer: Require every agent to lock a stake behind a reputation bond that decays when its behaviour diverges from the network's ledger of work. A new identity starts in the umber: untrusted, rate-limited, unable to claim rewards until peers attest real output. A prism of verifiers checks each claim against past performance, so one operator spinning up a thousand clones faces a thousand separate stakes and a thousand audits. Honest agents build a beacon of attested history that unlocks higher-value tasks, while sybils burn capital faster than they can earn it back.
